create_ManagedImage3U8: create a ManagedImage3U8 object to hold 3-channel 8-bit image data
create_ManagedImageU8: create a ManagedImageU8 object to hold single-channel 8-bit grayscale image data
convert_image_to_numpy: call to_numpy_array on a ManagedImage3U8 to convert image data to a numpy array
access_pixel_value: call at on an Image3U8 to get the pixel value at a given x, y, and channel
debayer_raw_image: call debayer on a 2D numpy array of raw Bayer pattern grayscale image data
